text: { "entries": [ { "name_han": "無上黃籙大齋立成儀", "logic_thesis": "Salvation is not granted by emotion or belief alone but by a complete, codified ritual system that realigns the dead with cosmic bureaucracy. The text proves that orderly liturgical sequence—confession, petition, lamp rites, deliverance—can transfer merit across the barrier of death because Heaven responds to form as much as intent. Thus ritual completeness itself is the causal engine of universal salvation.", "logic_chain": "1) The dead remain bound by karmic and bureaucratic debt in the underworld. 2) Heaven and the Three Realms operate by documentary and ceremonial procedure, not arbitrary grace. 3) A fully structured zhai (retreat) reconstitutes the petitioner as a lawful agent before the celestial courts. 4) Each rite (confession, lamps, memorials, baths, bridges) removes a specific obstruction in that legal-cosmic chain. 5) When the chain is complete, merit is transferable and souls are released. 6) Therefore systematic ritual form is the necessary and sufficient medium of large-scale salvation.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling for death, ancestral debt, or chronic 'ghost affliction,' treat the chart's weak Fire/Earth as need for ritual light and ground, not only fortunetelling. 2) Map life crises as incomplete 'registers'—confession (self-audit), petition (clear intention), lamp (yang qi restoration). 3) Use sequential cultivation: purify body → declare intent → sustain luminous awareness → release attachment, mirroring the zhai order. 4) For lineage or family curses, design multi-day practice calendars rather than one-off charms. 5) Judge efficacy by completeness of process, not intensity of feeling.", "logic_compare": "Unlike shorter Lingbao lamp or vow texts, this work argues at the scale of a full bureaucratic cosmos: salvation is industrial, not personal. Compared with Shangqing interior visualization, it privileges external, communal, documentary liturgy. It differs from pure morality scriptures by treating form itself—not only virtue—as soteriological cause." }, { "name_han": "洞玄靈寶齋說光燭戒罰燈祝願儀", "logic_thesis": "Light, precept, punishment, and vow form one causal circuit: illumination without discipline is unstable, discipline without light is blind. The text proves that ritual lamps are not décor but instruments that make moral order visible and enforceable in the body of the assembly. Vow completes the circuit by binding future conduct to present luminosity.", "logic_chain": "1) Spiritual assembly gathers in darkness of ignorance and impurity. 2) Candles/lamps generate yang radiance that marks sacred space and reveals fault. 3) Precepts define the boundary of that light; violations attract penalty. 4) Penalty is not mere retribution but restoration of ritual integrity. 5) Vows project the purified order into future time. 6) Therefore light–precept–penalty–vow is a single logic of making morality operative.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, when Fire is weak or chaotic, pair lighting practice (candle/meditation on brightness) with concrete precepts, not visualization alone. 2) Use 'lamp stages' in cultivation: outer light → inner clarity → vow of non-regression. 3) Treat repeated chart disasters as failed penalty-restoration: name the broken rule, accept a corrective austerity, re-vow. 4) Design daily practice as light (attention) + code (precept) + review (self-penalty) + rededication. 5) For clients, convert vague guilt into a lit protocol of confession and limited penance.", "logic_compare": "It is narrower than the full Huanglu zhai: it isolates the optical-moral engine of the retreat rather than the entire salvation bureaucracy. Unlike pure precept codes (e.g. Laojun's chanted precepts), it ties ethics to physical light technology. Compared with abstract 'mind-light' Chan rhetoric, it insists light must be ritualized and socially enforced." }, { "name_han": "太上洞玄靈寶授度儀", "logic_thesis": "Transmission is a legal-cosmic transfer of rank, not a private insight. The text proves that spiritual authority is valid only when conferred through registered rite, witnesses, and documents that re-place the disciple inside the Lingbao hierarchy. Without ordination form, knowledge remains powerless before spirits and courts.", "logic_chain": "1) Daoist power is hierarchical and register-based. 2) Untransmitted practice is usurpation and invites spirit refusal or calamity. 3) Ordination rites create a new identity by oath, talisman, scripture, and ranking. 4) The celestial bureaucracy acknowledges only those properly entered on the rolls. 5) Therefore efficacy of later ritual depends on prior lawful 授度. 6) Lineage continuity is the maintenance of this legal personhood across generations.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi mentor-disciple work, treat 'true transmission' as alignment of day-master with a clear hierarchical Fire/Metal structure (authority + code). 2) Before advanced methods, require formal vow and recorded commitment analogous to register entry. 3) Diagnose failed magic/cultivation as missing 'ordination conditions'—unclear teacher, no precept, no accountability. 4) Use chart periods of Officer/Seal as natural windows for initiation and rank-taking. 5) Practice as staged empowerment: study → purification → oath → receive symbol → exercise under supervision.", "logic_compare": "Unlike Zuowanglun's interior path where authority is self-verified by stillness, this text locates authority in external legal form. It differs from Huanglu salvation rites by focusing on living initiation rather than dead deliverance. Compared with Shangqing 'overpass' (過度) sexuality rites, Lingbao 授度 is clerical and scriptural, not bodily dual-cultivation." }, { "name_han": "玉音法事", "logic_thesis": "Sacred sound is not accompaniment but a causal force that orders qi, summons deities, and seals ritual speech. The text proves that correctly pitched, timed, and worded liturgical music aligns human breath with celestial harmonics, making petition audible to Heaven. Wrong sound breaks efficacy even if intention is pure.", "logic_chain": "1) Cosmos is structured as resonant pattern (律). 2) Human ritual must match that pattern through voice, melody, and pause. 3) Jade-sound liturgy encodes the correct acoustic protocol for each liturgical act. 4) Matching sound moves qi and commands spiritual response. 5) Mismatch scatters qi and voids the rite. 6) Therefore musicology is theology: form of sound is form of power.", "logic_practice": "1) In cultivation, treat breath-and-tone (mantra, recitation pitch) as primary yang regulator when chart Metal/Wood are in conflict. 2) Recite scriptures at steady cadence; avoid emotional shouting that breaks 玉音 restraint. 3) Use BaZi luck hours of Metal (voice) or Fire (resonance) for major petitions. 4) Diagnose ritual failure as acoustic disorder: fix tempo and purity of words before adding more talismans. 5) Train 'one sound, one intent'—each phrase carries one clear administrative request.", "logic_compare": "Unlike silent Zuowang, it claims salvation and command work through disciplined sound. Differing from Beidi mantra scriptures that weaponize syllables against demons, 玉音法事 perfects communal liturgical harmony rather than martial exorcism. Compared with pure literary scripture, it treats performance parameters as doctrinal." }, { "name_han": "老君音誦誡經", "logic_thesis": "The Dao reforms a corrupt age by replacing chaotic spirit traffic with audible, communal precept chanting under a new covenant. Kou Qianzhi's logic proves that moral law must be recited into the body politic: sound installs order, and order expels false gods and illicit cult. Salvation of the state begins as liturgical discipline of the people.", "logic_chain": "1) End-time disorder arises from false sacrifices, sexual rites, and unregulated mediumship. 2) Laojun descends to reissue the pure Way of the Covenant. 3) Precepts must be chanted (音誦), not merely stored as text, so they inhabit breath and community. 4) Chanted law reclassifies spirits: legitimate vs. illicit. 5) Those who obey re-enter the correct celestial register; rebels face eschatological purge. 6) Therefore social-religious reform is achieved by sonic institutionalization of precepts.", "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi charts marked by 'illicit spirit' patterns (heavy Sha, chaotic Output without Officer), prescribe daily recited codes over random spirit-calling. 2) Convert vague morality into numbered, chantable rules. 3) Use group recitation to stabilize family or community karma. 4) When clients chase secret techniques, redirect to audible precept first—order before power. 5) Time reform practices to 7/7 or other covenant-associated calendrical markers if lineage uses them.", "logic_compare": "Unlike Lingbao universal salvation banquets, this is a theocratic purge text: purity over inclusion. It differs from Nüqing's demon statutes by targeting living human cult practice as much as ghosts. Compared with Zuowang's elite interior quietism, it is public, oral, and political." }, { "name_han": "坐忘論", "logic_thesis": "The Dao is attained by progressive subtraction of mental grasping until no self remains to obstruct unity. Sima Chengzhen proves that technique without forgetting becomes new bondage; only graduated sitting-in-oblivion yields stable union. Cultivation success is measured by loss of contrivance, not accumulation of visions.", "logic_chain": "1) Ordinary mind is agitated by desire, knowledge, and self-image. 2) Forced suppression creates rebound; clever methods recreate ego. 3) Stages (respect, detachment, concentration, contemplation, true observation, stillness, oblivion) dismantle layers in order. 4) When even the thought of attainment drops, Dao appears as the mind's original clarity. 5) Residual attachment to quiet or power restarts the cycle. 6) Therefore the logical end of practice is non-practice: 坐忘.", "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi with strong Output/Hurting Officer and weak Seal, train progressive 'forget skill' after basic method is stable. 2) Sequence daily practice: ethics → posture → breath → watching → release of watcher. 3) Treat visionary fireworks as intermediate traps, not goals. 4) In chart reading, use Zuowang logic: identify which 'layer of self' the luck pillar is inflating, then prescribe the matching renunciation. 5) Verify progress by reduced reactivity under Officer pressure, not by psychic phenomena.", "logic_compare": "Radically interior versus the liturgical-external corpus (Huanglu, 玉音, 授度). Unlike Shangqing's elaborate visualization pantheon, it distrusts image accumulation. It differs from Beidi/Zhenwu martial exorcism by dissolving the demon-fighting subject rather than arming it." }, { "name_han": "三天內解經", "logic_thesis": "Sacred history is a succession of covenantal regimes; the present 'Three Heavens' order supersedes older, polluted dispensations. The text proves orthodoxy by narrative: correct gods, calendars, and sexual-ritual bans define the true Way against archaic or rival practices. Legitimacy is historical-legal, not merely mystical.", "logic_chain": "1) Earlier ages operated under different celestial administrations and mixed rites. 2) Corruption entered through improper blood sacrifice and illicit union rites. 3) A new Three Heavens covenant restructures pantheon and law. 4) Texts and practices are true only if aligned with this new administration. 5) Rival claims are reclassified as residual or demonic. 6) Therefore doctrine is proven by placement within sacred history's legal shift.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi lineage work, distinguish 'old fate patterns' (inherited cult/family taboos) from current correctable code. 2) When clients practice mixed systems, apply Three Heavens logic: one primary covenant, clear bans. 3) Use chart clashes as signs of dual administration—resolve by choosing one ethical-ritual center. 4) Teach that changing luck requires changing 'regime' of habits, not only charms. 5) Date major life reforms to clear seasonal nodes as miniature 'new covenant' moments.", "logic_compare": "More historiographic than pure ritual manuals; it argues by cosmic politics of eras. Unlike 老君音誦誡經's focus on chanted precepts, it supplies the mythic constitution behind the reform. Compared with geographic immortality texts (十洲記, 洞天福地), it maps time-regimes rather than sacred space." }, { "name_han": "鄧天君玄靈八門報應內旨", "logic_thesis": "Retribution is a navigable structure of eight gates, not blind fate; each gate encodes a causal channel between act, spirit office, and result. The text proves that by knowing the gate-logic of 報應, the adept can anticipate, block, or reverse calamity through correct petition and method. Morality becomes operational engineering of response paths.", "logic_chain": "1) Human deeds open specific spiritual response channels. 2) These channels are organized as eight gates with distinct qualities of return (benefit/harm, speed, agent). 3) Ignorance of gate structure makes suffering seem random. 4) Esoteric knowledge maps deed → gate → officer → outcome. 5) Ritual and repentance can shut or divert a gate before full manifestation. 6) Therefore retribution is lawful, legible, and partially steerable.", "logic_practice": "1) Map BaZi 'sha' and annual afflictors onto eight-gate style categories: sudden vs. slow, interior vs. exterior, self-caused vs. ancestral. 2) For each disaster type, prescribe the matching gate remedy (confession, offering, exorcism, charity). 3) Use day-selection as choosing which response channel is open. 4) Train clients to track act→result chains for 49 or 100 days as empirical 報應 literacy. 5) Never treat punishment as pure psychology—address the 'office' (habit structure) that enforces it.", "logic_compare": "More technical and tactical than general morality books; it resembles a systems manual of karma routes. Unlike Nüqing's demon law code aimed at cataloging ghosts, it theorizes human access to retribution mechanics. Differing from Zuowang, it engages the bureaucracy of consequences rather than transcending the actor." }, { "name_han": "洞玄靈寶五感文", "logic_thesis": "True retreat begins when the adept generates five precise affective realizations that break worldly numbness. The text proves that ritual without structured feeling is empty form, while feeling without ritual dissipates; the five 感 supply the motivational logic that makes zhai ethically real. Emotion is disciplined into salvific knowledge.", "logic_chain": "1) People enter rites with distraction and self-interest. 2) Without deep affective turn, confession and vow stay verbal. 3) Five reflections (on parents, teachers, living beings, suffering, grace of Dao, etc.—as classically structured) reorient the heart. 4) Reoriented affect fuels sincere repentance and offering. 5) Sincerity makes the ritual legible to Heaven. 6) Therefore cultivated feeling is a necessary premise of efficacious liturgy.", "logic_practice": "1) Before BaZi remediation or ritual, require a written five-point gratitude/repentance inventory. 2) For cold, calculating chart types (strong Metal, dry Water), use 五感 to reintroduce ethical warmth before technique. 3) Sequence sessions: feeling-work → vow → technical rite. 4) When practice plateaus, return to the five reflections rather than adding methods. 5) Measure success by sustained compassion under stress, not by ritual drama.", "logic_compare": "It is the affective interior of Lingbao zhai, complementing Huanglu's procedural exterior. Unlike Zuowang's drive toward emotion-forgetting, it first intensifies right emotion. Compared with pure precept texts, it motivates law by pathos rather than threat alone." }, { "name_han": "元辰章醮立成曆", "logic_thesis": "Personal destiny (元辰) is administrable through correctly timed chapter-offerings; calendar is the interface between natal fate and celestial offices. The text proves that petition succeeds when day, deity, and document match the person's star-destiny structure. Fate is not only read but scheduled into negotiation.", "logic_chain": "1) Each person has a yuanchen configuration linking birth data to spirit officers. 2) Misfortune is often misalignment or debt with those officers. 3) Zhang-jiao (documented offerings) communicate in bureaucratic form. 4) A fixed calendar specifies when channels open and which rites fit which afflictions. 5) Correct timing multiplies efficacy; wrong timing nullifies or harms. 6) Therefore destiny work is calendrical administration, not vague prayer.", "logic_practice": "1) Integrate BaZi day-master and annual pillars with jiao calendars: choose offerings when useful gods are strong. 2) For 元辰 affliction years, prefer documented petition over generic temple visits. 3) Build personal ritual almanacs: which month to resolve career, illness, lawsuits. 4) Treat missed timing as unfinished paperwork—resubmit at next lawful window. 5) Teach clients that 'luck changing' requires scheduled acts matching their chart's open doors.", "logic_compare": "More personalized and calendrical than communal Huanglu salvation. Unlike pure natal BaZi reading, it assumes the chart is a docket to be acted on through 醮. Differing from geographic immortal maps, it maps time slots of access rather than places of power." }, { "name_han": "上清黃書過度儀", "logic_thesis": "Cosmic order can be restored in the body through ritually timed sexual dual practice that enacts Heaven-Earth conjunction. The text proves (within its Shangqing early logic) that regulated union under calendrical and directional rules is a technē of transcendence, not lust—disorderly sex is the anti-rite. Embodiment is the altar of cosmic repair.", "logic_chain": "1) Human microcosm mirrors Heaven-Earth. 2) Qi decline and social chaos mirror failed conjunction of yin-yang. 3) Properly timed, directed, and visualized sexual rites rejoin the two principles. 4) Registers and rules prevent the act from collapsing into desire. 5) Successful 過度 moves the adept across ontological rank. 6) Therefore body-rite, under strict law, is a path of salvation (as this tradition claims).", "logic_practice": "1) In modern BaZi ethics, extract the structural lesson only: yin-yang timing, restraint, and calendrical discipline—not illicit replication of the rite. 2) Use the text as historical warning: techniques without covenant become the 'false arts' later reforms banned. 3) For couples' chart counseling, emphasize mutual regulation of desire as qi economy. 4) Apply 過度 as metaphor for life-stage transitions requiring ritualized boundary-crossing. 5) Prefer sublimated practices (breath, meditation pairing of Fire-Water) over literal sexual liturgy.", "logic_compare": "Maximally somatic versus Lingbao's clerical documentary salvation and Zuowang's asexual quietism. It is precisely what 老君音誦誡經 and 三天內解經 polemicize against when corrupted. Compared with Beidi martial purity cults, it seeks power through conjunction rather than exorcistic separation." }, { "name_han": "太上元始天尊說北帝伏魔神咒妙經", "logic_thesis": "Demonic disorder yields to the North Emperor's authority enacted through revealed mantras that carry executive force. The text proves that evil is juridically subordinate: correct speech-acts from a higher throne compel, bind, and dissolve spirits. Exorcism is application of hierarchical law via sonic decree.", "logic_chain": "1) Plagues and spirits afflict because lower powers act without check. 2) Beidi holds northern martial-judicial mandate. 3) Yuanshi's revelation authorizes humans to voice Beidi's decrees as 神咒. 4) Mantra plus intent instantiates that mandate on site. 5) Demons must submit or be destroyed under cosmic law. 6) Therefore sacred speech is enforceable judgment, not petition alone.", "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi years of Sha overlapping illness/haunting signatures, use northern-direction, Water/Metal-toned purification and mantra discipline. 2) Recite with judicial mind: name the disorder, cite higher authority, command separation. 3) Pair sound with clean altar geometry (north focus). 4) Strengthen day-master's Officer/Seven-Killings correctly: authority without panic. 5) After exorcistic practice, close with precept to avoid reopening gates.", "logic_compare": "More martial-judicial than Lingbao's merciful universal salvation tone. Unlike Zuowang, it multiplies forceful images and syllables. Compared with Zhenwu scripture, it centers Beidi's throne and curse-power; Zhenwu often personalizes the northern perfected warrior path." }, { "name_han": "北帝伏魔經法建壇儀", "logic_thesis": "Mantra power requires a correctly built spatial machine: the altar is the hardware that localizes Beidi's court. The text proves that without geometric, directional, and procedural construction, spells lack jurisdiction. Space is law made visible.", "logic_chain": "1) Spiritual authority needs a seat of government. 2) Altar construction replicates northern cosmic headquarters in miniature. 3) Materials, directions, paces, and sequence install that jurisdiction. 4) Only then do scriptures and mantras operate 'inside court.' 5) A flawed altar creates legal defect; spirits ignore or invert commands. 6) Therefore architecture and procedure are premises of martial liturgy.", "logic_practice": "1) Before any strong exorcistic BaZi remediation, fix practice space: clean north sector, stable center, clear hierarchy of objects. 2) Treat desk/altar as court: no clutter = no mixed dockets. 3) Time 建壇 to Metal/Water days or northern monthly commands. 4) Train entering/leaving altar as changing legal status (profane ↔ official). 5) Diagnose failed rites as spatial defects first, mantra second.", "logic_compare": "It operationalizes the Beidi scripture's verbal authority into blueprints—hardware vs. software. Unlike Huanglu's vast multi-day salvation complex, it is a focused martial court setup. Differing from 洞天福地 geography of natural sacred sites, it manufactures sacred jurisdiction indoors." }, { "name_han": "太上北極伏魔神咒殺鬼籙", "logic_thesis": "The register (籙) is a portable commission: holding it enrolls the adept as a licensed ghost-killer under the northern pole. The text proves that efficacy against demons depends on documentary rank as much as personal courage or secret knowledge. Identity-as-officer is the true talisman.", "logic_chain": "1) Ghosts obey offices, not private will. 2) A 籙 is a celestial warrant listing powers, troops, and limits. 3) Transmission of the kill-ghost register confers lawful northern mandate. 4) Spells cast under that warrant commandeer registered spirit soldiers. 5) Without 籙, action is vigilantism and fails against ranked demons. 6) Therefore exorcism is badge-and-writ logic applied to the unseen.", "logic_practice": "1) In contemporary practice, treat 'lineage authorization' and ethical license as functional 籙—do not freelance heavy rites. 2) For BaZi, when Seven-Killings is strong, cultivate as official force under Seal (license), not raw violence. 3) Keep a personal 'register' journal of vows, methods allowed, and methods forbidden. 4) Renew commitment periodically as re-validation of warrant. 5) Use northern pole symbolism (still center, rotating function) in meditation: calm axis, decisive action.", "logic_compare": "More credential-focused than the narrative Beidi sutra or the architectural 建壇儀. Aligns with Lingbao 授度 on transmission legality but specializes in martial ghost warfare. Unlike Nüqing's statutes aimed at classifying demons, this empowers a human officer against them." }, { "name_han": "元始天尊說北方真武妙經", "logic_thesis": "Zhenwu embodies perfected northern martial virtue: demon-subduing is the fruit of prior self-subdual and celestial appointment. The text proves that a personal divine model—ascetic, armored, true—mediates between abstract Dao and human crisis. Devotion restructures the adept after the archetype of the North's perfected warrior.", "logic_chain": "1) Chaos and demons express disordered will. 2) Zhenwu's hagiography shows conversion of fierce power into true martial order. 3) Yuanshi's discourse authorizes invocation of that model. 4) Recitation and worship imprint Zhenwu's virtues on the petitioner. 5) Protected by that imprint, the adept overcomes inner and outer demons. 6) Therefore personified northern perfection is a soteriological technology.", "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi charts with wet, dark, or chaotic Water and uncontrolled Killings, take Zhenwu as regulating archetype: purity, courage, restraint. 2) Combine physical discipline (posture, cold exposure carefully, martial qigong) with recitation. 3) Face north in meditation; visualize armor as ethical boundaries. 4) Apply to career conflict: fight only under 'true' (真) motive, not ego. 5) Annual north-sector cleanup and vow days as Zhenwu maintenance.", "logic_compare": "More devotional-personal than Beidi's imperial-judicial curse complex, though both are northern and martial. Unlike Zuowang's impersonal forgetting, it uses strong iconic identity. Compared with Dragon King rain scriptures, it targets moral-martial disorder rather than meteorological imbalance." }, { "name_han": "太上洞淵說請雨龍王經", "logic_thesis": "Drought is a breakdown of petition-relations with aquatic dragon administrations, repairable by correct scriptural plea. The text proves that weather is bureaucratically mediated: rain is released when human community addresses the right Dragon Kings through Dongyuan authority. Ecology is liturgy.", "logic_chain": "1) Rain depends on dragon offices governing waters. 2) Human sin, neglect, or wrong rites interrupt their beneficence. 3) Dongyuan revelation supplies the proper invitation protocol. 4) Collective recitation and offering re-open the channel. 5) Dragons respond by releasing rain, restoring agricultural order. 6) Therefore climatic crisis is addressed as inter-office diplomacy, not only material technique.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, chronic 'dry' patterns (strong Fire/Earth, weak Water) can be remedied symbolically by Water-honoring practice and generosity. 2) For community stress, use collective rather than solitary petition models. 3) Time Water-related remedies to wet stems/branches and dragon-associated hours. 4) Treat resource droughts (money, inspiration) with the same logic: name the 'office,' apologize for waste, request regulated flow. 5) Avoid coercive spirit threats; this text's logic is 請 (invitation), not 殺.", "logic_compare": "Conciliatory and ecological versus Beidi/Zhenwu's combative demonology. Unlike Huanglu's focus on postmortem souls, it negotiates living environmental offices. Differing from pure geographic records of waters, it provides speech protocol to activate them." }, { "name_han": "女青鬼律", "logic_thesis": "The spirit world is a punishable population under statute; naming ranks and crimes of ghosts creates enforceable order. The text proves that early Celestial Master power rests on legal knowledge of demons—catalog, penalty, and human compliance with demon-law. Control begins with classification.", "logic_chain": "1) Disorder arises from unregulated ghosts and human collusion. 2) Nüqing statutes list species, crimes, and punishments. 3) Knowing a ghost's legal identity enables binding and sentencing. 4) Humans who violate related purity rules fall under the same punitive cosmos. 5) Community safety depends on applying the code, not bargaining randomly. 6) Therefore demonology is jurisprudence.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi 'ghost' years or illness charts, first classify: internal (emotion/addiction) vs. external (environment/family), acute vs. chronic—statute before spell. 2) Keep personal purity rules that close invitation channels (sleep, sex, substances, speech). 3) Use naming in journaling: precise labels reduce amorphous fear. 4) Prefer rule-based remedies over endless talisman shopping. 5) When counseling, translate 'haunting' into which law of life was broken and how to restore it.", "logic_compare": "Earlier, harsher, and more catalogic than later merciful Lingbao salvation of wandering souls. Unlike Deng Tianjun's eight-gate retribution interiors for human deeds, 女青 focuses on ghost populations. Compared with Beidi kill-registers, it is the law book demons themselves are under, not only the officer's warrant." }, { "name_han": "洞天福地嶽瀆名山記", "logic_thesis": "Immortality and spiritual administration are geographically distributed; sacred mountains, grottos, and water systems are offices of the Dao on earth. The text proves that cultivation and pilgrimage succeed by aligning with this spatial bureaucracy of 洞天福地. Place is rank and function, not scenery.", "logic_chain": "1) Heaven's order is mirrored in terrestrial sacred nodes. 2) Each grotto-heaven/blessed land has governors, qi quality, and specialty. 3) Human practice is amplified when located in matching nodes. 4) Misplaced practice wastes effort or invites wrong spirits. 5) Recording names and hierarchies preserves access knowledge. 6) Therefore sacred geography is a practical map of spiritual jurisdiction.", "logic_practice": "1) Match BaZi elemental needs to landscapes: Water deficiency → rivers/islands; Wood → eastern mountains, etc. 2) Design retreats in environments that supply the chart's missing qi. 3) Treat home feng shui as micro 洞天: clear center, defined gates, clean water paths. 4) Pilgrimage with intent to a named office, not tourism. 5) When urban-bound, build symbolic 'grotto' (quiet room, altar cave-niche) as portable blessed land.", "logic_compare": "Spatial catalog versus 十洲記's more mythic overseas paradises; this text is more administrative-terrestrial. Unlike altar-building manuals that manufacture sacred space, it inventories pre-existing cosmic real estate. Differing from pure inner alchemy, it insists outer place still matters." }, { "name_han": "十洲記", "logic_thesis": "Ultimate goods—immortality herbs, long-life isles, rare qi—exist in structured overseas continents accessible to the worthy. The text proves desire for transcendence by cosmography: the world is larger than the empire and hides graded paradises. Imagination of distance becomes a logic of aspiration and selection.", "logic_chain": "1) Ordinary land is depleted and mortal. 2) Ten continents and three islands store superior substances and beings. 3) Access depends on destiny, virtue, and sometimes imperial/Daoist mission. 4) Mapping them makes the invisible economy of immortality thinkable. 5) Aspiration without map is fantasy; map without virtue is closed. 6) Therefore geographic myth encodes a hierarchy of attainable excellence.", "logic_practice": "1) Use as BaZi vision work: identify the client's 'far continent'—true long-term excellence beyond local competition. 2) Pair ambition with virtue requirements implied by island guardians. 3) For strong Traveling-Star patterns, convert restlessness into structured quest, not escape. 4) Meditation: sail imagination to one isle, retrieve one quality (clarity, courage, temperance), return—no spiritual tourism addiction. 5) Distinguish exotic craving from genuine 仙 orientation.", "logic_compare": "More marvelous and peripheral than 洞天福地's domestic sacred bureaucracy. Less liturgical than zhai manuals; it persuades by wonder-catalog. Compared with 洞淵集's later encyclopedic miscellany, 十洲記 is a focused island-paradise treatise of early medieval imagination." }, { "name_han": "洞淵集", "logic_thesis": "Daoist knowledge is a field of many streams that must be gathered, compared, and ordered without collapsing into one technique. The collection form proves that cultivation wisdom is cumulative and multi-genre—lore, method, anecdote, and doctrine correct each other. Completeness of perspective is itself a safeguard against sectarian error.", "logic_chain": "1) Single-method fixation breeds bias and failure. 2) Dongyuan traditions already span scripture, ritual, and narrative. 3) Anthologizing preserves variants and cross-checks. 4) The reader gains a higher-order logic: when to apply which stream. 5) Integration yields resilient practice under changing conditions. 6) Therefore compilation is an epistemological method, not mere storage.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi mastery, build a personal 洞淵集: classical rules, case notes, failed predictions, ritual outcomes. 2) When stuck, switch genre of approach (calendar → morality → meditation → geography). 3) Teach students comparative reading to avoid guru monoculture. 4) Quarterly review: which methods overused, which neglected. 5) Treat contradictory texts as situational tools, not all-true/all-false absolutes.", "logic_compare": "Unlike any single sutra or ritual protocol, its logic is meta-textual: truth by assemblage. Differing from 坐忘論's linear path to one end-state, it remains plural. Compared with early short revelations (女青, 音誦誡), it represents mature archival Daoism that curates rather than only decrees." } ] }
thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from 20 classical Daoist/BaZi-related texts and return structured JSON. This is a scholarly extraction task about Daoist ritual, liturgy, and cultivation...I understand you're looking to extract logical reasoning from these classical Daoist/BaZi-related texts, focusing on ritual, liturgy, and cultivation themes, and structure it into JSON.

entries.logic_thesis: Salvation is not granted by emotion or belief alone but by a complete, codified ritual system that realigns the dead with cosmic bureaucracy. The text proves that orderly liturgical sequence—confession, petition, lamp rites, deliverance—can transfer merit across the barrier of death because Heaven responds to form as much as intent. Thus ritual completeness itself is the causal engine of universal salvation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The dead remain bound by karmic and bureaucratic debt in the underworld. 2) Heaven and the Three Realms operate by documentary and ceremonial procedure, not arbitrary grace. 3) A fully structured zhai (retreat) reconstitutes the petitioner as a lawful agent before the celestial courts. 4) Each rite (confession, lamps, memorials, baths, bridges) removes a specific obstruction in that legal-cosmic chain. 5) When the chain is complete, merit is transferable and souls are released. 6) Therefore systematic ritual form is the necessary and sufficient medium of large-scale salvation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi counseling for death, ancestral debt, or chronic 'ghost affliction,' treat the chart's weak Fire/Earth as need for ritual light and ground, not only fortunetelling. 2) Map life crises as incomplete 'registers'—confession (self-audit), petition (clear intention), lamp (yang qi restoration). 3) Use sequential cultivation: purify body → declare intent → sustain luminous awareness → release attachment, mirroring the zhai order. 4) For lineage or family curses, design multi-day practice calendars rather than one-off charms. 5) Judge efficacy by completeness of process, not intensity of feeling.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike shorter Lingbao lamp or vow texts, this work argues at the scale of a full bureaucratic cosmos: salvation is industrial, not personal. Compared with Shangqing interior visualization, it privileges external, communal, documentary liturgy. It differs from pure morality scriptures by treating form itself—not only virtue—as soteriological cause.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶齋說光燭戒罰燈祝願儀
entries.logic_thesis: Light, precept, punishment, and vow form one causal circuit: illumination without discipline is unstable, discipline without light is blind. The text proves that ritual lamps are not décor but instruments that make moral order visible and enforceable in the body of the assembly. Vow completes the circuit by binding future conduct to present luminosity.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Spiritual assembly gathers in darkness of ignorance and impurity. 2) Candles/lamps generate yang radiance that marks sacred space and reveals fault. 3) Precepts define the boundary of that light; violations attract penalty. 4) Penalty is not mere retribution but restoration of ritual integrity. 5) Vows project the purified order into future time. 6) Therefore light–precept–penalty–vow is a single logic of making morality operative.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, when Fire is weak or chaotic, pair lighting practice (candle/meditation on brightness) with concrete precepts, not visualization alone. 2) Use 'lamp stages' in cultivation: outer light → inner clarity → vow of non-regression. 3) Treat repeated chart disasters as failed penalty-restoration: name the broken rule, accept a corrective austerity, re-vow. 4) Design daily practice as light (attention) + code (precept) + review (self-penalty) + rededication. 5) For clients, convert vague guilt into a lit protocol of confession and limited penance.
entries.logic_compare: It is narrower than the full Huanglu zhai: it isolates the optical-moral engine of the retreat rather than the entire salvation bureaucracy. Unlike pure precept codes (e.g. Laojun's chanted precepts), it ties ethics to physical light technology. Compared with abstract 'mind-light' Chan rhetoric, it insists light must be ritualized and socially enforced.

entries.logic_thesis: Transmission is a legal-cosmic transfer of rank, not a private insight. The text proves that spiritual authority is valid only when conferred through registered rite, witnesses, and documents that re-place the disciple inside the Lingbao hierarchy. Without ordination form, knowledge remains powerless before spirits and courts.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Daoist power is hierarchical and register-based. 2) Untransmitted practice is usurpation and invites spirit refusal or calamity. 3) Ordination rites create a new identity by oath, talisman, scripture, and ranking. 4) The celestial bureaucracy acknowledges only those properly entered on the rolls. 5) Therefore efficacy of later ritual depends on prior lawful 授度. 6) Lineage continuity is the maintenance of this legal personhood across generations.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi mentor-disciple work, treat 'true transmission' as alignment of day-master with a clear hierarchical Fire/Metal structure (authority + code). 2) Before advanced methods, require formal vow and recorded commitment analogous to register entry. 3) Diagnose failed magic/cultivation as missing 'ordination conditions'—unclear teacher, no precept, no accountability. 4) Use chart periods of Officer/Seal as natural windows for initiation and rank-taking. 5) Practice as staged empowerment: study → purification → oath → receive symbol → exercise under supervision.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Zuowanglun's interior path where authority is self-verified by stillness, this text locates authority in external legal form. It differs from Huanglu salvation rites by focusing on living initiation rather than dead deliverance. Compared with Shangqing 'overpass' (過度) sexuality rites, Lingbao 授度 is clerical and scriptural, not bodily dual-cultivation.

entries.logic_thesis: Sacred sound is not accompaniment but a causal force that orders qi, summons deities, and seals ritual speech. The text proves that correctly pitched, timed, and worded liturgical music aligns human breath with celestial harmonics, making petition audible to Heaven. Wrong sound breaks efficacy even if intention is pure.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmos is structured as resonant pattern (律). 2) Human ritual must match that pattern through voice, melody, and pause. 3) Jade-sound liturgy encodes the correct acoustic protocol for each liturgical act. 4) Matching sound moves qi and commands spiritual response. 5) Mismatch scatters qi and voids the rite. 6) Therefore musicology is theology: form of sound is form of power.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In cultivation, treat breath-and-tone (mantra, recitation pitch) as primary yang regulator when chart Metal/Wood are in conflict. 2) Recite scriptures at steady cadence; avoid emotional shouting that breaks 玉音 restraint. 3) Use BaZi luck hours of Metal (voice) or Fire (resonance) for major petitions. 4) Diagnose ritual failure as acoustic disorder: fix tempo and purity of words before adding more talismans. 5) Train 'one sound, one intent'—each phrase carries one clear administrative request.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike silent Zuowang, it claims salvation and command work through disciplined sound. Differing from Beidi mantra scriptures that weaponize syllables against demons, 玉音法事 perfects communal liturgical harmony rather than martial exorcism. Compared with pure literary scripture, it treats performance parameters as doctrinal.

entries.logic_thesis: The Dao reforms a corrupt age by replacing chaotic spirit traffic with audible, communal precept chanting under a new covenant. Kou Qianzhi's logic proves that moral law must be recited into the body politic: sound installs order, and order expels false gods and illicit cult. Salvation of the state begins as liturgical discipline of the people.
entries.logic_chain: 1) End-time disorder arises from false sacrifices, sexual rites, and unregulated mediumship. 2) Laojun descends to reissue the pure Way of the Covenant. 3) Precepts must be chanted (音誦), not merely stored as text, so they inhabit breath and community. 4) Chanted law reclassifies spirits: legitimate vs. illicit. 5) Those who obey re-enter the correct celestial register; rebels face eschatological purge. 6) Therefore social-religious reform is achieved by sonic institutionalization of precepts.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts marked by 'illicit spirit' patterns (heavy Sha, chaotic Output without Officer), prescribe daily recited codes over random spirit-calling. 2) Convert vague morality into numbered, chantable rules. 3) Use group recitation to stabilize family or community karma. 4) When clients chase secret techniques, redirect to audible precept first—order before power. 5) Time reform practices to 7/7 or other covenant-associated calendrical markers if lineage uses them.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Lingbao universal salvation banquets, this is a theocratic purge text: purity over inclusion. It differs from Nüqing's demon statutes by targeting living human cult practice as much as ghosts. Compared with Zuowang's elite interior quietism, it is public, oral, and political.

entries.logic_thesis: The Dao is attained by progressive subtraction of mental grasping until no self remains to obstruct unity. Sima Chengzhen proves that technique without forgetting becomes new bondage; only graduated sitting-in-oblivion yields stable union. Cultivation success is measured by loss of contrivance, not accumulation of visions.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ordinary mind is agitated by desire, knowledge, and self-image. 2) Forced suppression creates rebound; clever methods recreate ego. 3) Stages (respect, detachment, concentration, contemplation, true observation, stillness, oblivion) dismantle layers in order. 4) When even the thought of attainment drops, Dao appears as the mind's original clarity. 5) Residual attachment to quiet or power restarts the cycle. 6) Therefore the logical end of practice is non-practice: 坐忘.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi with strong Output/Hurting Officer and weak Seal, train progressive 'forget skill' after basic method is stable. 2) Sequence daily practice: ethics → posture → breath → watching → release of watcher. 3) Treat visionary fireworks as intermediate traps, not goals. 4) In chart reading, use Zuowang logic: identify which 'layer of self' the luck pillar is inflating, then prescribe the matching renunciation. 5) Verify progress by reduced reactivity under Officer pressure, not by psychic phenomena.
entries.logic_compare: Radically interior versus the liturgical-external corpus (Huanglu, 玉音, 授度). Unlike Shangqing's elaborate visualization pantheon, it distrusts image accumulation. It differs from Beidi/Zhenwu martial exorcism by dissolving the demon-fighting subject rather than arming it.

entries.logic_thesis: Sacred history is a succession of covenantal regimes; the present 'Three Heavens' order supersedes older, polluted dispensations. The text proves orthodoxy by narrative: correct gods, calendars, and sexual-ritual bans define the true Way against archaic or rival practices. Legitimacy is historical-legal, not merely mystical.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Earlier ages operated under different celestial administrations and mixed rites. 2) Corruption entered through improper blood sacrifice and illicit union rites. 3) A new Three Heavens covenant restructures pantheon and law. 4) Texts and practices are true only if aligned with this new administration. 5) Rival claims are reclassified as residual or demonic. 6) Therefore doctrine is proven by placement within sacred history's legal shift.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi lineage work, distinguish 'old fate patterns' (inherited cult/family taboos) from current correctable code. 2) When clients practice mixed systems, apply Three Heavens logic: one primary covenant, clear bans. 3) Use chart clashes as signs of dual administration—resolve by choosing one ethical-ritual center. 4) Teach that changing luck requires changing 'regime' of habits, not only charms. 5) Date major life reforms to clear seasonal nodes as miniature 'new covenant' moments.
entries.logic_compare: More historiographic than pure ritual manuals; it argues by cosmic politics of eras. Unlike 老君音誦誡經's focus on chanted precepts, it supplies the mythic constitution behind the reform. Compared with geographic immortality texts (十洲記, 洞天福地), it maps time-regimes rather than sacred space.

entries.name_han: 鄧天君玄靈八門報應內旨
entries.logic_thesis: Retribution is a navigable structure of eight gates, not blind fate; each gate encodes a causal channel between act, spirit office, and result. The text proves that by knowing the gate-logic of 報應, the adept can anticipate, block, or reverse calamity through correct petition and method. Morality becomes operational engineering of response paths.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human deeds open specific spiritual response channels. 2) These channels are organized as eight gates with distinct qualities of return (benefit/harm, speed, agent). 3) Ignorance of gate structure makes suffering seem random. 4) Esoteric knowledge maps deed → gate → officer → outcome. 5) Ritual and repentance can shut or divert a gate before full manifestation. 6) Therefore retribution is lawful, legible, and partially steerable.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map BaZi 'sha' and annual afflictors onto eight-gate style categories: sudden vs. slow, interior vs. exterior, self-caused vs. ancestral. 2) For each disaster type, prescribe the matching gate remedy (confession, offering, exorcism, charity). 3) Use day-selection as choosing which response channel is open. 4) Train clients to track act→result chains for 49 or 100 days as empirical 報應 literacy. 5) Never treat punishment as pure psychology—address the 'office' (habit structure) that enforces it.
entries.logic_compare: More technical and tactical than general morality books; it resembles a systems manual of karma routes. Unlike Nüqing's demon law code aimed at cataloging ghosts, it theorizes human access to retribution mechanics. Differing from Zuowang, it engages the bureaucracy of consequences rather than transcending the actor.

entries.logic_thesis: True retreat begins when the adept generates five precise affective realizations that break worldly numbness. The text proves that ritual without structured feeling is empty form, while feeling without ritual dissipates; the five 感 supply the motivational logic that makes zhai ethically real. Emotion is disciplined into salvific knowledge.
entries.logic_chain: 1) People enter rites with distraction and self-interest. 2) Without deep affective turn, confession and vow stay verbal. 3) Five reflections (on parents, teachers, living beings, suffering, grace of Dao, etc.—as classically structured) reorient the heart. 4) Reoriented affect fuels sincere repentance and offering. 5) Sincerity makes the ritual legible to Heaven. 6) Therefore cultivated feeling is a necessary premise of efficacious liturgy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before BaZi remediation or ritual, require a written five-point gratitude/repentance inventory. 2) For cold, calculating chart types (strong Metal, dry Water), use 五感 to reintroduce ethical warmth before technique. 3) Sequence sessions: feeling-work → vow → technical rite. 4) When practice plateaus, return to the five reflections rather than adding methods. 5) Measure success by sustained compassion under stress, not by ritual drama.
entries.logic_compare: It is the affective interior of Lingbao zhai, complementing Huanglu's procedural exterior. Unlike Zuowang's drive toward emotion-forgetting, it first intensifies right emotion. Compared with pure precept texts, it motivates law by pathos rather than threat alone.

entries.logic_thesis: Personal destiny (元辰) is administrable through correctly timed chapter-offerings; calendar is the interface between natal fate and celestial offices. The text proves that petition succeeds when day, deity, and document match the person's star-destiny structure. Fate is not only read but scheduled into negotiation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Each person has a yuanchen configuration linking birth data to spirit officers. 2) Misfortune is often misalignment or debt with those officers. 3) Zhang-jiao (documented offerings) communicate in bureaucratic form. 4) A fixed calendar specifies when channels open and which rites fit which afflictions. 5) Correct timing multiplies efficacy; wrong timing nullifies or harms. 6) Therefore destiny work is calendrical administration, not vague prayer.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Integrate BaZi day-master and annual pillars with jiao calendars: choose offerings when useful gods are strong. 2) For 元辰 affliction years, prefer documented petition over generic temple visits. 3) Build personal ritual almanacs: which month to resolve career, illness, lawsuits. 4) Treat missed timing as unfinished paperwork—resubmit at next lawful window. 5) Teach clients that 'luck changing' requires scheduled acts matching their chart's open doors.
entries.logic_compare: More personalized and calendrical than communal Huanglu salvation. Unlike pure natal BaZi reading, it assumes the chart is a docket to be acted on through 醮. Differing from geographic immortal maps, it maps time slots of access rather than places of power.

entries.logic_thesis: Cosmic order can be restored in the body through ritually timed sexual dual practice that enacts Heaven-Earth conjunction. The text proves (within its Shangqing early logic) that regulated union under calendrical and directional rules is a technē of transcendence, not lust—disorderly sex is the anti-rite. Embodiment is the altar of cosmic repair.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human microcosm mirrors Heaven-Earth. 2) Qi decline and social chaos mirror failed conjunction of yin-yang. 3) Properly timed, directed, and visualized sexual rites rejoin the two principles. 4) Registers and rules prevent the act from collapsing into desire. 5) Successful 過度 moves the adept across ontological rank. 6) Therefore body-rite, under strict law, is a path of salvation (as this tradition claims).
entries.logic_practice: 1) In modern BaZi ethics, extract the structural lesson only: yin-yang timing, restraint, and calendrical discipline—not illicit replication of the rite. 2) Use the text as historical warning: techniques without covenant become the 'false arts' later reforms banned. 3) For couples' chart counseling, emphasize mutual regulation of desire as qi economy. 4) Apply 過度 as metaphor for life-stage transitions requiring ritualized boundary-crossing. 5) Prefer sublimated practices (breath, meditation pairing of Fire-Water) over literal sexual liturgy.
entries.logic_compare: Maximally somatic versus Lingbao's clerical documentary salvation and Zuowang's asexual quietism. It is precisely what 老君音誦誡經 and 三天內解經 polemicize against when corrupted. Compared with Beidi martial purity cults, it seeks power through conjunction rather than exorcistic separation.

entries.name_han: 太上元始天尊說北帝伏魔神咒妙經
entries.logic_thesis: Demonic disorder yields to the North Emperor's authority enacted through revealed mantras that carry executive force. The text proves that evil is juridically subordinate: correct speech-acts from a higher throne compel, bind, and dissolve spirits. Exorcism is application of hierarchical law via sonic decree.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Plagues and spirits afflict because lower powers act without check. 2) Beidi holds northern martial-judicial mandate. 3) Yuanshi's revelation authorizes humans to voice Beidi's decrees as 神咒. 4) Mantra plus intent instantiates that mandate on site. 5) Demons must submit or be destroyed under cosmic law. 6) Therefore sacred speech is enforceable judgment, not petition alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi years of Sha overlapping illness/haunting signatures, use northern-direction, Water/Metal-toned purification and mantra discipline. 2) Recite with judicial mind: name the disorder, cite higher authority, command separation. 3) Pair sound with clean altar geometry (north focus). 4) Strengthen day-master's Officer/Seven-Killings correctly: authority without panic. 5) After exorcistic practice, close with precept to avoid reopening gates.
entries.logic_compare: More martial-judicial than Lingbao's merciful universal salvation tone. Unlike Zuowang, it multiplies forceful images and syllables. Compared with Zhenwu scripture, it centers Beidi's throne and curse-power; Zhenwu often personalizes the northern perfected warrior path.

entries.logic_thesis: Mantra power requires a correctly built spatial machine: the altar is the hardware that localizes Beidi's court. The text proves that without geometric, directional, and procedural construction, spells lack jurisdiction. Space is law made visible.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Spiritual authority needs a seat of government. 2) Altar construction replicates northern cosmic headquarters in miniature. 3) Materials, directions, paces, and sequence install that jurisdiction. 4) Only then do scriptures and mantras operate 'inside court.' 5) A flawed altar creates legal defect; spirits ignore or invert commands. 6) Therefore architecture and procedure are premises of martial liturgy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before any strong exorcistic BaZi remediation, fix practice space: clean north sector, stable center, clear hierarchy of objects. 2) Treat desk/altar as court: no clutter = no mixed dockets. 3) Time 建壇 to Metal/Water days or northern monthly commands. 4) Train entering/leaving altar as changing legal status (profane ↔ official). 5) Diagnose failed rites as spatial defects first, mantra second.
entries.logic_compare: It operationalizes the Beidi scripture's verbal authority into blueprints—hardware vs. software. Unlike Huanglu's vast multi-day salvation complex, it is a focused martial court setup. Differing from 洞天福地 geography of natural sacred sites, it manufactures sacred jurisdiction indoors.

entries.name_han: 太上北極伏魔神咒殺鬼籙
entries.logic_thesis: The register (籙) is a portable commission: holding it enrolls the adept as a licensed ghost-killer under the northern pole. The text proves that efficacy against demons depends on documentary rank as much as personal courage or secret knowledge. Identity-as-officer is the true talisman.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ghosts obey offices, not private will. 2) A 籙 is a celestial warrant listing powers, troops, and limits. 3) Transmission of the kill-ghost register confers lawful northern mandate. 4) Spells cast under that warrant commandeer registered spirit soldiers. 5) Without 籙, action is vigilantism and fails against ranked demons. 6) Therefore exorcism is badge-and-writ logic applied to the unseen.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In contemporary practice, treat 'lineage authorization' and ethical license as functional 籙—do not freelance heavy rites. 2) For BaZi, when Seven-Killings is strong, cultivate as official force under Seal (license), not raw violence. 3) Keep a personal 'register' journal of vows, methods allowed, and methods forbidden. 4) Renew commitment periodically as re-validation of warrant. 5) Use northern pole symbolism (still center, rotating function) in meditation: calm axis, decisive action.
entries.logic_compare: More credential-focused than the narrative Beidi sutra or the architectural 建壇儀. Aligns with Lingbao 授度 on transmission legality but specializes in martial ghost warfare. Unlike Nüqing's statutes aimed at classifying demons, this empowers a human officer against them.

entries.name_han: 元始天尊說北方真武妙經
entries.logic_thesis: Zhenwu embodies perfected northern martial virtue: demon-subduing is the fruit of prior self-subdual and celestial appointment. The text proves that a personal divine model—ascetic, armored, true—mediates between abstract Dao and human crisis. Devotion restructures the adept after the archetype of the North's perfected warrior.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Chaos and demons express disordered will. 2) Zhenwu's hagiography shows conversion of fierce power into true martial order. 3) Yuanshi's discourse authorizes invocation of that model. 4) Recitation and worship imprint Zhenwu's virtues on the petitioner. 5) Protected by that imprint, the adept overcomes inner and outer demons. 6) Therefore personified northern perfection is a soteriological technology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts with wet, dark, or chaotic Water and uncontrolled Killings, take Zhenwu as regulating archetype: purity, courage, restraint. 2) Combine physical discipline (posture, cold exposure carefully, martial qigong) with recitation. 3) Face north in meditation; visualize armor as ethical boundaries. 4) Apply to career conflict: fight only under 'true' (真) motive, not ego. 5) Annual north-sector cleanup and vow days as Zhenwu maintenance.
entries.logic_compare: More devotional-personal than Beidi's imperial-judicial curse complex, though both are northern and martial. Unlike Zuowang's impersonal forgetting, it uses strong iconic identity. Compared with Dragon King rain scriptures, it targets moral-martial disorder rather than meteorological imbalance.

entries.name_han: 太上洞淵說請雨龍王經
entries.logic_thesis: Drought is a breakdown of petition-relations with aquatic dragon administrations, repairable by correct scriptural plea. The text proves that weather is bureaucratically mediated: rain is released when human community addresses the right Dragon Kings through Dongyuan authority. Ecology is liturgy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Rain depends on dragon offices governing waters. 2) Human sin, neglect, or wrong rites interrupt their beneficence. 3) Dongyuan revelation supplies the proper invitation protocol. 4) Collective recitation and offering re-open the channel. 5) Dragons respond by releasing rain, restoring agricultural order. 6) Therefore climatic crisis is addressed as inter-office diplomacy, not only material technique.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, chronic 'dry' patterns (strong Fire/Earth, weak Water) can be remedied symbolically by Water-honoring practice and generosity. 2) For community stress, use collective rather than solitary petition models. 3) Time Water-related remedies to wet stems/branches and dragon-associated hours. 4) Treat resource droughts (money, inspiration) with the same logic: name the 'office,' apologize for waste, request regulated flow. 5) Avoid coercive spirit threats; this text's logic is 請 (invitation), not 殺.
entries.logic_compare: Conciliatory and ecological versus Beidi/Zhenwu's combative demonology. Unlike Huanglu's focus on postmortem souls, it negotiates living environmental offices. Differing from pure geographic records of waters, it provides speech protocol to activate them.

entries.logic_thesis: The spirit world is a punishable population under statute; naming ranks and crimes of ghosts creates enforceable order. The text proves that early Celestial Master power rests on legal knowledge of demons—catalog, penalty, and human compliance with demon-law. Control begins with classification.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Disorder arises from unregulated ghosts and human collusion. 2) Nüqing statutes list species, crimes, and punishments. 3) Knowing a ghost's legal identity enables binding and sentencing. 4) Humans who violate related purity rules fall under the same punitive cosmos. 5) Community safety depends on applying the code, not bargaining randomly. 6) Therefore demonology is jurisprudence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi 'ghost' years or illness charts, first classify: internal (emotion/addiction) vs. external (environment/family), acute vs. chronic—statute before spell. 2) Keep personal purity rules that close invitation channels (sleep, sex, substances, speech). 3) Use naming in journaling: precise labels reduce amorphous fear. 4) Prefer rule-based remedies over endless talisman shopping. 5) When counseling, translate 'haunting' into which law of life was broken and how to restore it.
entries.logic_compare: Earlier, harsher, and more catalogic than later merciful Lingbao salvation of wandering souls. Unlike Deng Tianjun's eight-gate retribution interiors for human deeds, 女青 focuses on ghost populations. Compared with Beidi kill-registers, it is the law book demons themselves are under, not only the officer's warrant.

entries.logic_thesis: Immortality and spiritual administration are geographically distributed; sacred mountains, grottos, and water systems are offices of the Dao on earth. The text proves that cultivation and pilgrimage succeed by aligning with this spatial bureaucracy of 洞天福地. Place is rank and function, not scenery.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven's order is mirrored in terrestrial sacred nodes. 2) Each grotto-heaven/blessed land has governors, qi quality, and specialty. 3) Human practice is amplified when located in matching nodes. 4) Misplaced practice wastes effort or invites wrong spirits. 5) Recording names and hierarchies preserves access knowledge. 6) Therefore sacred geography is a practical map of spiritual jurisdiction.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Match BaZi elemental needs to landscapes: Water deficiency → rivers/islands; Wood → eastern mountains, etc. 2) Design retreats in environments that supply the chart's missing qi. 3) Treat home feng shui as micro 洞天: clear center, defined gates, clean water paths. 4) Pilgrimage with intent to a named office, not tourism. 5) When urban-bound, build symbolic 'grotto' (quiet room, altar cave-niche) as portable blessed land.
entries.logic_compare: Spatial catalog versus 十洲記's more mythic overseas paradises; this text is more administrative-terrestrial. Unlike altar-building manuals that manufacture sacred space, it inventories pre-existing cosmic real estate. Differing from pure inner alchemy, it insists outer place still matters.

entries.logic_thesis: Ultimate goods—immortality herbs, long-life isles, rare qi—exist in structured overseas continents accessible to the worthy. The text proves desire for transcendence by cosmography: the world is larger than the empire and hides graded paradises. Imagination of distance becomes a logic of aspiration and selection.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ordinary land is depleted and mortal. 2) Ten continents and three islands store superior substances and beings. 3) Access depends on destiny, virtue, and sometimes imperial/Daoist mission. 4) Mapping them makes the invisible economy of immortality thinkable. 5) Aspiration without map is fantasy; map without virtue is closed. 6) Therefore geographic myth encodes a hierarchy of attainable excellence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use as BaZi vision work: identify the client's 'far continent'—true long-term excellence beyond local competition. 2) Pair ambition with virtue requirements implied by island guardians. 3) For strong Traveling-Star patterns, convert restlessness into structured quest, not escape. 4) Meditation: sail imagination to one isle, retrieve one quality (clarity, courage, temperance), return—no spiritual tourism addiction. 5) Distinguish exotic craving from genuine 仙 orientation.
entries.logic_compare: More marvelous and peripheral than 洞天福地's domestic sacred bureaucracy. Less liturgical than zhai manuals; it persuades by wonder-catalog. Compared with 洞淵集's later encyclopedic miscellany, 十洲記 is a focused island-paradise treatise of early medieval imagination.

entries.logic_thesis: Daoist knowledge is a field of many streams that must be gathered, compared, and ordered without collapsing into one technique. The collection form proves that cultivation wisdom is cumulative and multi-genre—lore, method, anecdote, and doctrine correct each other. Completeness of perspective is itself a safeguard against sectarian error.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Single-method fixation breeds bias and failure. 2) Dongyuan traditions already span scripture, ritual, and narrative. 3) Anthologizing preserves variants and cross-checks. 4) The reader gains a higher-order logic: when to apply which stream. 5) Integration yields resilient practice under changing conditions. 6) Therefore compilation is an epistemological method, not mere storage.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi mastery, build a personal 洞淵集: classical rules, case notes, failed predictions, ritual outcomes. 2) When stuck, switch genre of approach (calendar → morality → meditation → geography). 3) Teach students comparative reading to avoid guru monoculture. 4) Quarterly review: which methods overused, which neglected. 5) Treat contradictory texts as situational tools, not all-true/all-false absolutes.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike any single sutra or ritual protocol, its logic is meta-textual: truth by assemblage. Differing from 坐忘論's linear path to one end-state, it remains plural. Compared with early short revelations (女青, 音誦誡), it represents mature archival Daoism that curates rather than only decrees.
